backlog.fix: Map/intro/help header world title in cream #FFF3D6 with a 2px dark-brown outline, contrast >= 4.5:1, font-size clamp() so it fits on <= 2 lines at 390px. Title screen: logo gets a 3px dark outline and drop shadow; subtitle and tagline sit on a 40%-opacity dark scrim at >= 4.5:1. Also lifts UI.

On mobile, place callouts with their full bounds (stroke, shadow and peak scale included) in the painting band above the frame; on desktop, in the side column under the HUD box. Test: no callout pixel intersects a cell rectangle in any frame.

Cascade: a full-width glowing stripe band with arrow fins >= 30% of the cell and a 1.2s additive pulse. Hot Stone: an emissive orange-hot core with an ember rim and shimmer, replacing the dark disc and gold scribble. Test: every special is identifiable in a frame downscaled to 50%.

Over 150ms before a special fires, scale it to 1.2x with an additive glow build-up (fills the dead s1 frames 2-4). On fire, an 8px board shake decaying over 250ms, and the frame rim flashes in the special's colour. Test: the dwell frames differ, and the board offset is non-zero in the fire frame.

Crust: a white crystalline overlay with facets and sparkle, with the HUD and goal icon textured the same (not a blank square). Moss: a leafy carpet overlapping the cell edges, not grapes. Steam: an opaque swirling cloud covering >= 70% of the piece. Tufa: one drab-grey tint on every board colour, with light-cream layer pips >= 6px. Also lifts readability.

Cascade beam: additive, >= 0.6 of a cell thick, with a soft falloff. Hot Stone: replace the opaque brown ring with an additive orange shockwave (alpha <= 0.6, expanding 0 to 1.5 cells). Shards >= 12px with gravity and spin.
On landing, each piece squashes to scale 1.1x0.85 for 60ms, rebounds to 0.97x1.04, then settles, staggered per column. Test: a strip frame catches a squashed piece.
Label the score-goal pill ("Goal 11,340"). Make the star bar >= 14px tall with each star at its real threshold, and pop each star to gold when it is reached.

Replace the cold grey frame on Worlds 2, 4 and 5 with a warm bronze gradient. Tint each world's cell fill from the painting's mid-tone darkened 60%, and feather the World 2 mobile fog band into the board halo.
Replace the 250px corner HUD box with a full-height left rail: a larger moves badge, goals and a star meter, with the boosters as a single vertical column, leaving no dead area beside it.
